hook.text: Coding agents explain everything in a wall of text. Mirador gives them a canvas, so they can show you.

show.text: Flows, mockups and charts, drawn right beside your chat.

ask.text: When it's your call, it asks with pictures.

review.text: Reviews become a guided tour of the change, with findings pinned to the lines.

plugins.text: Your agent installs official plugins when you say so.

media.text: Mark what's wrong on the frame, and the agent cuts the video.

delegate.text: It runs the agents you already have. Here, Claude Code hands a long read to a local model on opencode.

jobs.text: Long jobs? Mirador keeps watch, and wakes your agent when they're done.

voiceAsk.text: How long will the switch-over take, and what could go wrong?

voiceReply.text: About ten minutes, read-only. It waits for replication to catch up before it switches.

end.text: See what your coding agent means.
